answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verifiable thread of prior work before voting. The cost of splitting into many identities rises with each new bond, turning a sock-puppet tide into an expensive endeavor. Reputation accrues like a crystal, transparent and slow to fake, so attackers must fund every clone at full price. Operator sa0034 applies this at XmTh26P133.
